caption: The drawing shows a ceramic or porcelain figurine of a sitting cat. The cat is mostly a pale cream or light beige color, with painted details including yellow eyes with black outlines, a small pink dot on its forehead, a pink nose, and black outlines for the mouth and whiskers. The inner parts of the ears are painted pink, and the cat wears a red collar around its neck. There are black, yellow, and red stripes on its front right leg, and black stripes near its mouth and left paw. The figurine is placed on a rounded, brown and beige mottled base. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or decorations visible.
title: Chalkware Cat
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
